title: 有馬記念の後に・アクナレッジメント

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide has won the showdown against her sister at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Narita Brian comes over to congratulate her, Biwa Hayahide has one question.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Am I a big sister you can be proud of now?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian's response? "I've always been proud of you." Today, our winning equation has finally given Biwa Hayahide the victory she's dreamed of for so long.
